# Noobot v4.2.0

This release unifies the plugin layer and system event architecture, optimizes the codebase, and fixes bugs.

## Highlights

- Unified plugin contracts, activation, runtime contributions, and frontend integration.
- Unified system event production and delivery across runtime components.
- Optimized code structure, protocol boundaries, and runtime behavior.
- Fixed bugs affecting session execution, reconnect handling, and frontend state projection.
